description_short: Underground fluid pipes, Pipe Connectors and Pipe Balancers with batched flow arrows, direct layers and safe demolition for CoI 0.8.7a.
description_long: Routes the game's existing fluid pipes, Pipe Connectors and Pipe Balancers below terrain without replacement transport assets. Connector-on-pipe placement uses the native validated cut-out command only after confirmation, preserving products and route direction. Direct ALL/-1/-2/-3/-4 controls separate the visible/selectable layer from construction depth. Batched x-ray flow arrows use real moved-product steps; depth, product and diagnostics modes remain available. Burial depth follows compatible unlocked vanilla pipe tiers from T1 through T4 and is relative to local terrain, including excavated mines below sea level. Verified on Captain of Industry 0.8.7a (game build 614).
